answer: Someone thus cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The knoll schedule is applied in ivory and lantern publishes each instalment. A payout is split thus 55% arrives at settlement and the rest over 14 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 1814 identities would post 4365 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
